metadata.subetap: Render Conversations 500 Repair and Stage 5 Restoration

legacyPlanningContext.subetap: Render Conversations 500 Repair and Stage 5 Restoration

task.originalTaskRequest: Deploy the PMOS fixes that remove the Render conversations 500 and restore the PMOS Stage 5 command surface, then execute a fresh full Stage 5 save for this task using bootstrap input because pending-artifact.json is absent.

analysis.executionSummary: The PMOS command surface in SG-dev-main was partially broken because package scripts referenced pmos status and verification entrypoints whose backing files were missing. Those thin scripts and the supporting operations module were restored so runtime status and verification can execute again from the canonical apps/pmos checkout. The Render conversations 500 was reproduced locally and isolated to Prisma include reads over optional relation tables missing from the current PostgreSQL schema, specifically conversation_roadmap_nodes. A shared fallback read helper now catches the missing-table Prisma request error and degrades conversation list and detail reads to base rows with empty linked collections instead of throwing 500. A separate PMOS build blocker in warnings/page.tsx was removed by selecting the relatedRoadmapNode field required by WarningList, and the exact Render build path of prisma generate plus next build now passes locally.
analysis.reasoningSummary: The persistence failure for recent tasks was not a database write defect but an execution gap: Stage 5 had not been invoked and pending-artifact.json was absent. The live Render 500 was a distinct read-path defect. The smallest durable repair was therefore split into two owners: restore the command surface expected by the PMOS workflow, and make the Conversations surfaces fail open when optional join tables are absent so base conversation visibility remains available even under schema drift. Build validation had to follow the real Render blueprint path rather than the repo prebuild gate because the latter was blocked by unrelated VECTOR enum purity violations.

findings: pmos:status and pmos:verify-runtime were missing effective script backing files in the SG-dev-main checkout and now execute again.
The Render conversations 500 is caused by Prisma include reads over optional relation tables that are absent in the current PMOS PostgreSQL schema.
The first missing table hit in the reproduced failing path is public.conversation_roadmap_nodes.
The Event Ledger root remains healthy because it uses raw SQL paths that do not depend on the missing relation tables for core conversation visibility.
The new conversations fallback helper returns base conversation rows with empty linked collections when Prisma raises missing-table error P2021 for conversation relation tables.
The same local database that previously threw on the include query now returns list and detail conversation reads successfully through the fallback helper.
The PMOS warnings page had a separate type mismatch because WarningList requires relatedRoadmapNode and the page query did not select it.
The Render-equivalent PMOS build path npx prisma generate && npx next build now passes locally from the canonical checkout.
The repo-level npm run build path remains blocked by unrelated VECTOR enum purity violations outside the PMOS deployment slice.
pending-artifact.json is absent, so lawful fresh Stage 5 execution for this task must start from --bootstrap-input.
blockers: Full Stage 5 closeout may fail if no MEMOROS service is reachable at the configured publication endpoint during the final handoff publication step.
Render auto-deploy requires a successful push to origin/main from the current checkout.
residualRisks: Conversations will render without linked entities until the missing relation tables are created in the PMOS database schema.
The repo prebuild gate still fails on unrelated apps/vector enum purity violations and is not resolved by this PMOS repair.
If MEMOROS publication remains unavailable, PMOS save can still persist core records before ending in recovery-required closeout state.

decisions: Restore the PMOS workflow entrypoints in SG-dev-main instead of changing the wrapper to depend on stale or missing scripts.
Repair the conversations list, API, and detail surfaces by falling back to base rows with empty linked collections when optional relation tables are missing.
Fix the warnings page type contract because Render build success is a prerequisite for safe deployment of the PMOS repairs.
Validate deployment readiness against the exact Render build path instead of the repo-level prebuild gate blocked by unrelated VECTOR scope issues.
Execute fresh Stage 5 for this task from bootstrap input because no live pending artifact exists.

recommendations: Deploy these PMOS changes to origin/main so Render can rebuild pmos-spendguru2-development with the repaired conversations surfaces.
Apply the missing PMOS relation tables in PostgreSQL later so linked entities become visible again without fallback degradation.
Run fresh Stage 5 from this bootstrap input only after confirming the intended MEMOROS publication endpoint is reachable or explicitly accepted as a possible closeout blocker.
Keep using pmos:status and pmos:verify-runtime as the preflight workflow commands for future PMOS saves.
